explanation: This is the Torque definition of JSGeneratorObject from objects/js-generator.tq, showing the actual fields and their types. This is the source-of-truth for the object layout. Key fields include: function (the generator function), context (execution context), receiver (this value), input_or_debug_pos (input value or bytecode offset), resume_mode (kNext/kReturn/kThrow/kRethrow), continuation (state), and parameters_and_registers (saved register file). Async variants add promise and queue fields.
